messages:
anya: quick note from today's handoff — the history scrubber doesn't speak when you land on a past state. SR users hear nothing and get confused.

olivia: thanks for flagging. expected: announce date/time + active variants. something like: "Timeline: 2025-09-10 16:22 UTC 3 showing v4.0.1 (stable), v4.0.3 (canary 15%)"

mike: also the scrubber handle has no visible focus at small widths. can we add a 3px --focus-accent ring and increase hit area to 44px?

tashi: microcopy: the rollback confirmation is terse. change primary to "Rollback to previous stable" and add a one-line consequence: "Traffic will redirect to v4.0.1; this action is reversible only via new deployment."

ben: accessibility note for the variant pills: they need aria-describedby linking to a short status text (e.g., "serving 15% of traffic"). also keyboard users need a clear tab order: row toggle -> slider -> commit preview -> rollback.

anya: action items:
- olivia: add SR announcement text for scrubber (owner: olivia)
- mike: focus styles + hit target (owner: mike)
- tashi: update rollback microcopy & modal hint (owner: tashi)
- ben: aria-describedby for variant pills + tab order doc (owner: ben)

design-bot: created ticket D-1263: "History scrubber SR announcement + rollback copy + focus targets" https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/D-1263

olivia: I'll prototype the aria-live snippet and drop it in the Figma file later today. ping me for VoiceOver checks.
